weekly.title: 2 for 1 on burgers & steaks
weekly.text: Every Belle Burger and every minute steak, 11.30am to 7pm.

weekly.title: Wine-y Thursday
weekly.text: Buy two large glasses of wine and the rest of the bottle's free. All day.

weekly.title: Fizz Friday
weekly.text: Half-price bottles of Prosecco and a third off every bottle of Champagne Piaff. All day.

weekly.title: Kids eat free
weekly.text: One under-12 eats free off the kids' menu with every paying adult main, until 7pm.

weekly.title: Sunday roast
weekly.text: Unlimited Yorkshires and veg from midday till it's gone. Kids still eat free (not the kids' roast).
